source_title: Diverse GABAergic neurons organize into subtype-specific sublaminae in the ventral lateral geniculate nucleus
section: | Do laminated retinorecipient circuits organize visual pathways through the vLGN?
node_relevance_reason: Electrophysiology/morphology suggest GAD67-GFP-labelled vLGN cells are interneurons while other GABAergic subtypes are likely projection neurons.
summary: Sabbagh et al. conclude that GAD67-GFP-labelled vLGN cells are likely interneurons, whereas other GABAergic subtypes in vLGN are probably projection neurons.
quotes: Our electrophysiological and morphological analyses of some of these cell types suggests that cells labeled in GAD67-GFP mice are likely vLGN interneurons.
Based on their preponderance in the vLGN, it is likely that at least some of the other subtypes of GABAergic neurons here are projection neurons.

source_title: Retinal inputs signal astrocytes to recruit interneurons into visual thalamus
node_relevance_reason: Gad67-GFP labels GABAergic interneurons in vLGN, but only a subset of the diverse GABAergic cells outside adult dLGN.
summary: Gad67-GFP mice have a large number of GFP+ interneurons in vLGN; the line is a faithful interneuron reporter in dLGN but labels only a subset of GABAergic cells elsewhere in visual thalamus.
quotes: A large number of GFP + interneurons are also present in the vLGN of these mice;
Thus, while Gad67-GFP is a faithful reporter line for GABAergic interneurons in the adult dLGN, it labels only a subset of the diverse GABAergic cells in other regions of the visual thalamus.

source_title: Pattern of Driver-Like Input onto Neurons of the Mouse Ventral Lateral Geniculate Nucleus
node_relevance_reason: Gad67-GFP interneurons populate vLGNe (and dLGN) but are absent from vLGNi, giving anatomical location within vLGN.
summary: GAD67-GFP-labelled GABAergic interneurons are found in vLGNe and dLGN but not in vLGNi.
quotes: Moreover, GABAergic interneurons labeled in the GAD67-GFP transgenic reporter line populate both vLGNe and dLGN but are absent from vLGNi (Su et al., 2011).

source_title: Retinal Input Is Required for the Maintenance of Neuronal Laminae in the Ventrolateral Geniculate Nucleus
node_relevance_reason: Distinguishes local interneurons (retinal-input-dependent migration, GAD67-GFP) from Ecel1+/Penk+ GABAergic principal/projection neurons in vLGN.
summary: Ecel1+ and Penk+ vLGN GABAergic cells do not need retinal input and are likely projection neurons, whereas GAD67-GFP interneurons require retinal input to migrate into vLGN.
quotes: In contrast, our previous studies have demonstrated that GFP-labeled interneurons in the GAD67-GFP mouse line do require retinal inputs to properly migrate into vLGN (Su et al., 2020).
Taken together, these data begin to suggest that retinal inputs exert different influences on principal (projection) neurons than on local interneurons in vLGN.

source_title: A Role for Thalamic Projection GABAergic Neurons in Circadian Responses to Light
node_relevance_reason: Sox14 marks LGv/IGL GABAergic projection neurons, whereas thalamic local interneurons also express Sox14 but have a mesencephalic origin.
summary: Sparse local-circuit interneurons of thalamocortical nuclei express Sox14 with a mesencephalic origin, distinct from IGL/LGv Sox14+ GABAergic thalamic neurons.
quotes: While the sparse interneurons of the mouse thalamocortical nuclei also express Sox14, these local circuit cells have a distinctive mesencephalic origin

source_title: Retinal inputs signal astrocytes to recruit interneurons into visual thalamus
node_relevance_reason: GFP+ interneurons in Gad67-GFP mice are initially concentrated in vLGN at birth then shift to dLGN over the first postnatal week.
summary: At P0 most GFP+ interneurons in visual thalamus are in vLGN; during the first postnatal week their numbers rise in dLGN and fall in vLGN.
quotes: Over the first week of postnatal development, this distribution shifted, with the dLGN showing a rapid increase and the vLGN a concomitant decrease in GFP + interneuron number

source_title: Sonic hedgehog-dependent recruitment of GABAergic interneurons into the developing visual thalamus
node_relevance_reason: Describes retinal-SHH/FGF15-dependent recruitment of GABAergic interneurons into dLGN and vLGN.
summary: Migration of GABAergic interneurons into perinatal dLGN and vLGN requires RGC innervation, via retinal SHH driving astrocytic FGF15.
quotes: Specifically, the recruitment of migrating interneurons into the perinatal dLGN and vLGN requires the embryonic and neonatal innervation of these regions by RGC axons.
Instead, we discovered that retinal-derived sonic hedgehog (SHH) is necessary for interneuron recruitment.

source_title: Retinal inputs signal astrocytes to recruit interneurons into visual thalamus
node_relevance_reason: Retinal input regulates FGF15-dependent recruitment of GABAergic interneurons into both dLGN and vLGN.
summary: Retinal input induces astrocytic FGF15, and loss of FGF15 impairs interneuron recruitment into dLGN and vLGN.
quotes: Here, we add to this emergent knowledge by demonstrating that retinal input regulates the recruitment of GABAergic interneurons into the dLGN and vLGN

node_relevance_reason: Discussion speculates vLGN inhibitory neurons are mainly projection rather than local; no direct interneuron data.

quotes: If these inhibitory neurons are primarily projection neurons, then the high inhibition in visual processing between nuclei (as opposed to local inhibition within a nucleus) may suggest roles for vLGN in modulating defensive behaviors and visuospatial processing.
